newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Three French die in light airplane crash in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Three French die in light airplane crash in Morocco.

text.p: Three French nationals, including a woman, were killed near the northern Moroccan city of Nador when their light airplane crashed, the official MAP news agency reported on Friday.

The single-engine PA28 crashed on Thursday, MAP said without identifying the victims. It blamed pilot error but gave no details. Nador is in the mountainous Rif area on the Mediterranean, known as a tourist destination.
